findings: Fypp templates emit unordered USE lists; the adapter sorts simple identifier-only lists, including continuations, before hashing. This produces identical checked Fortran on Windows and GNU/Linux without changing numerical operations. FPM did not discover base-hooks dependencies in the original CPP include; checksum-guarded staging edits repeat exactly that include's USE imports. The source manifest enables implicit external procedures, as required by legacy BLAS/LAPACK calls; an attempted environment warning override was ineffective and is not retained. Runtime and bounds checks remain active. The diagnostic macro uses __FILE__. MPI, OpenMP, LIBXS, LIBXSMM and accelerators are disabled.
